evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce EvoRiskBench, an evolving benchmark organized around the EP-Path-EF framework, which links an initial risk entry point to a one-hop technical effect through an agent-mediated risk path.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Workspace agents combine large language models with execution harnesses to perform stateful, multi-step tasks that access or modify external resources.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: The most vulnerable configuration, Codex with DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813, reaches a 68.44% attack success rate (ASR), indicating that configuration of workspace agent is insufficient to ensure secure autonomous execution.

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
evidence.excerpt: The benchmark provides a reproducible dataset of 450 adversarial tasks across six scenarios.
